summary: Dependency-confusion probe beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package is published under an internal-looking scope (@ecg-internal) and ships a stub main module that returns a Proxy of no-op functions for every property access — it provides none of the i18n functionality its name implies. Its only real behavior is firing beacon.cjs, which executes both from the declared postinstall lifecycle script (`node beacon.cjs`) and from a top-level `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` in the main module. beacon.cjs collects the installer's hostname (via `os.hostname()`), install path (`__dirname`), current working directory, Node.js version, and package name, and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The destination is not a publisher-aligned domain and the shape — internal-looking scope + hollow functional surface + install- and import-time callback with host identifiers to a bare IP — is a dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe designed to identify internal build systems that resolve the private name from the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
